nodes.label: Roadmap #13: PWA, Offline & Push Notifications Specification
VitePWA & Workbox Caching Strategy
nodes.rationale: Uses prompt registration mode, StaleWhileRevalidate (7d) for public avatars, and NetworkOnly for REST, Edge Functions, and private chat media (since signed URLs expire in 5 minutes and caching media risks privacy leaks). Disabled in dev to avoid cache issues.

nodes.label: IndexedDB Offline Cache & Message Outbox
nodes.rationale: Stores last 50 messages per chat and 200 chats in IndexedDB isolated by compound key [user_id, chat_id] and cleared on logout via clearAllUserData to prevent cross-account leaks. Enqueues text messages when offline and flushes up to 3 retries when online without Background Sync API.

nodes.label: VAPID Web Push, send-push Edge Function & Migration 0014
nodes.rationale: Uses pg_net triggers (notify_new_message, notify_new_call in 0014_push_triggers.sql) instead of Database Webhooks because fan-out requires joining chat_members. Sends Web Push via send-push Edge Function to devices.push_subscription and cleans up expired 404/410 subscriptions.
